methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.

actual_scope: Source-bound independent audit of PR3729: integrality of a pooled 144-call idle invoice versus integrality after per-call normalization; a counterexample to the stronger ceiling in the stated unrestricted aggregate model.
scope_change_reason: The initial generic complex-mechanism suggestions overlap newer idle-ceiling work. Handoff-first/live inspection found a precise new acceptance-boundary claim in PR3729. This session audits that claim instead of searching a new packing; PR1685 already supplies the aggregate optimum theorem.
bottleneck_link: Prevent an unjustified reduction of the selected word packing headroom: identify the aggregation unit required for an integer ceiling before using it to reject candidates.
stop_rule: Finish the one normalization/acceptance implication using exact source-bound signs; stop without owner synthesis or claiming the pooled witness is physically admissible.

open_questions.blocked_by: No physical legal-group characterization is proved here; the aggregate optimum is a relaxation witness.
